'''Karkarodons''' were an aggressive, aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]] that hailed from the planet [[Karkaris/Legends|Karkaris]]. Some, like [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]], supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:KarkarodonHand-Deception.png|thumb|left|200px|The webbed hand of a Karkarodon]]
The amphibious Karkarodons had tall, slim bodies with webbed hands and feet. Their shark-like heads had pointed noses, gill slits, and many rows of razor-sharp teeth, which they used when attacking and eating. Karkarodons were skilled and fast swimmers, with [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] commander [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] being able to keep up with a Republic [[OMS Devilfish sub/Legends|OMS Devilfish sub]]. They attacked by grabbing the target and used their jaws for ripping and tearing.<ref name="Water War" />

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Separatist [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] led the Confederacy during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="Water War" /> During the attempted execution of [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], three [[Karkarodon enforcers/Legends|Karkarodon enforcers]] served as the would be executioners.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

Later, another [[Unidentified Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] was imprisoned in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], and provoked [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], ([[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise) getting his hand stabbed with a fork as a result.<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Carcharodon'' is the name of the genus that includes the [[Wikipedia:great white shark|great white shark]],<ref name="NatGeo">{{WebCite|url=https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/discover-fish/species-profiles/carcharodon-carcharias|text=White Shark - Carcharodon carcharias|work=[https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu Florida Museum of Natural History]|archivedate=20220729040706}}</ref> and Karkarodons themselves are based on sharks.

The Karkarodons first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode titled "[[Water War]]" the series [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].<ref name="Water War" />
